# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is a heavy-set young woman. Nell notes that a fairy queen with Flossie's weight would be unheard of, as a fairy queen needs to be slim.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Flossie is a moody, bold, and caustic-tongued individual who is frequently regarded as unpleasant and malicious. She is unhesitating when it comes to speaking her mind or asking bold questions, though she lacks a creative mind and struggles with arithmetic. She holds superstitious beliefs, such as believing the number thirteen brings terrible luck. Additionally, she tends to act haughtily even when achieving barely passing results, and she freely displays spiteful or mocking expressions toward others.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)_

## History

Flossie attended Brierley school as the last student in a long line of Tulks. Possessing a natural talent for balance, she successfully navigated the Pembroke garden fence when challenged to a dare by Nell Harcourt. After Nell suffered an injury, Flossie visited her bedridden rival. During preparations for a school concert, Flossie grew moody when she failed to get her desired role as the fairy queen, and she subsequently fell out with Julia Bell for three months after making a rude remark about her. At an exhibition, she won top prize for her knitted lace.

Flossie joined the Regent's class taught by Miss Thorne to prepare for entrance exams, though she struggled with arithmetic. During the June entrance exams, she warned Nell that being assigned number thirteen brought bad luck. She passed her entrance exams by a narrow three-point margin. Upon moving to town to attend Regent's Academy, she lodged in the same building as Frank Stockley and pursued the Second Class work. She earned a reputation at the Academy for being the most caustic-tongued student. Later, when Nell's prize story was published, Flossie disdainfully claimed that Nell had stolen the tale from an older publication.
